verdict.rationale: E2B is fundamentally a programmatic, headless sandbox platform. It offers SDK-driven sandbox create, run code and kill (e2b-docs-1, e2b-docs-6), and a CLI that explicitly documents env-var API-key auth as the recommended option for non-interactive CI/CD pipelines (e2b-docs-35, e2b-docs-9), with background exec and bulk shutdown commands (e2b-docs-38, e2b-docs-39). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, plus concrete CI pipeline examples (e.g., a GitHub Actions recipe).
